topic: Vegapunk's Egghead ending was a planned backup: recording, Punk Records and a twenty-year-old clone
title: Vegapunk's Egghead Ending Was Planned (One Piece)
description: Everyone says Vegapunk lost at Egghead. But the recording, Punk Records and Lilith's box all point to a backup he built on purpose. Which Vegapunk wakes up in Elbaph?
comment: Is the Vegapunk who wakes up in Elbaph the clone in Lilith's box, or the mind in Punk Records? Pick one.

lines.text: Vegapunk didn't lose at Egghead. He backed himself up.

shot.fallback: scientist with an apple shaped head in a futuristic lab

lines.text: Look at what happens right after Kizaru's blow in chapter 1108.
A recording starts playing in his lab all by itself, and it speaks to the whole world.

shot.fallback: giant scientist projection over the sea

lines.text: He recorded it earlier. A cornered man doesn't have time to build that.

shot.fallback: scientist looking at an approaching fleet

lines.text: Then Mars and York trace the signal to Punk Records, the library where his real mind lives.

shot.fallback: officials staring at a signal screen

lines.text: Because he took his brain out of that body years ago.

shot.search: Vegapunk apple head brain Punk Records
shot.fallback: glowing brain inside a giant machine

lines.text: And in chapter 1134, Lilith reveals a box taken from Egghead.

shot.fallback: pink haired girl opening a metal box

lines.text: Inside is a perfect clone of Vegapunk, made twenty years ago so the Government would not notice his departure.

shot.fallback: scientist body asleep in a glowing capsule

lines.text: The clone and the recording are canon. That he planned it is my theory.

shot.fallback: scientist drawing a chart on a board

lines.text: So the real question is which Vegapunk wakes up in Elbaph.

shot.fallback: girl building a laboratory among giants

lines.text: The clone with no memory of Egghead, or the mind in the clouds?
Either way, the Government only got the body he expected it to chase, because Vegapunk didn't lose at Egghead...

shot.fallback: scientist smiling in front of ships

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim naming Vegapunk and Egghead in the first line
self_check.loop: last line ends mid-sentence into line 1: 'because Vegapunk didn't lose at Egghead. He backed himself up.'
